sha_convention: sha256 over on-disk raw bytes (binary read, no line-ending normalization)
preregistered: Residual hypothesis: the eps=0 gate-class RMS ratio's +0.285% excess over the predicted 1.0 is bf16 cast-back reconstruction rounding, not a genuine eps-independent term. KILL: residual persists > 0.1% under fp32-through reconstruction. PASS: residual <= 0.1% AND twin_cosine_fp32 strictly closer to 1.0 than 0.9999995827674866. residual<=0.1% with cosine unchanged = INCONCLUSIVE-BY-RULE.
scope: fp32-reconstruction rider: admissibility control (unmodified eps0.05_control anchor), a non-gating bf16 cast-back cross-check (reproduces the banked +0.285% eps0 residual), and the actual rider leg (eps=0 down_proj reconstructed and loaded at TRUE float32, matmul executed via forward hooks at fp32, never cast back to bf16). NUMBERS + band classification per the frozen bands only; the coordinator adjudicates.

method.reconstruction: down_proj [1024,32768] block-twin d_a/d_b (fp32), d_mean=(d_a+d_b)/2; eps0_fp32 variant = cat([d_mean, d_mean], dim=1) kept at float32 (no cast to grown_dtype); loaded into the down_proj PARAMETER directly (bypassing load_state_dict's dtype-preserving copy_, which would have silently re-rounded it to bf16).
method.fp32_through_mechanism: forward_pre_hook upcasts the incoming (bf16) activation to float32 immediately before the down_proj matmul; forward_hook downcasts the float32 output back to bf16 immediately after -- isolates the down_proj computation itself at full fp32 precision, a single-variable change from the all-bf16 baseline pipeline.
method.capture: reproduces cbase_grow_rung2_gradpost_capture.py's capture_grad_post_gate (same manual_seed(42) position, same build_v0_model + load_state_dict, same _build_pinned_batch, same QAT/CE/MTP per-microstep loop).

bf16_castback_cross_check.note: non-gating cross-check that this script's own math agrees with the banked eps0-fingerprint receipt before trusting the fp32-through leg.

fp32_reconstruction_assessment.inconclusive_band: residual_pct <= 0.1 AND cosine NOT strictly closer (explicit clause)
